# USC Libraries

> USC Libraries provides comprehensive research resources, specialized subject libraries, and digital collections supporting the University of Southern California's academic community.

USC Libraries operates multiple specialized libraries across the University Park Campus and health sciences locations, serving diverse academic disciplines from business and engineering to cinematic arts and medicine. The system offers integrated research databases, subject librarian consultations, and special collections including archives and cultural heritage materials.

## Key Topics

- Library locations and hours
- Subject librarians
- Research databases
- Special Collections

## Getting Started

- [Home | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu): USC Libraries homepage with access to research databases and digital collections
- [Ask A Librarian | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/ask-a-librarian): Reference service for chat, email, and subject librarian consultations
- [Library Hours | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/hours): Operating hours for all USC Libraries locations

## Major Library Locations

- [Doheny Memorial Library | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/doheny-memorial-library): Historic Doheny Memorial Library with study spaces and reference room
- [Leavey Library | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/leavey-library): Thomas and Dorothy Leavey Library providing student resources and services
- [Norris Medical Library | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/norris-medical-library): Norris Medical Library with medical research databases and liaison services
- [Science & Engineering Library | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/science-engineering-library): Science & Engineering Library with research databases and academic resources

## Specialized Subject Libraries

- [Gaughan & Tiberti Business Library | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/gaughan-tiberti-library): Gaughan & Tiberti Business Library serving USC Marshall School of Business
- [Accounting Library | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/accounting-library): Accounting Library serving Leventhal School of Accounting and Marshall School
- [Cinematic Arts Library | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/cinematic-arts-library): Cinematic Arts Library supporting School of Cinematic Arts with archives
- [Architecture & Fine Arts Library | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/architecture-and-fine-arts-library): Architecture & Fine Arts Library in Watt Hall with specialized collections
- [Music Library | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/music-library): Music Library serving performing arts schools with specialized collections
- [East Asian Library | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/east-asian-library): East Asian Library with specialized collections and study rooms
- [Hoose Library of Philosophy | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/hoose-library-philosophy): Hoose Library of Philosophy with specialized philosophy research databases

## Collections & Archives

- [Special Collections | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/special-collections): Special Collections providing primary sources and archival research access
- [Welcome | One Archives](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/one-archives): ONE Archives LGBTQ+ cultural history collection with exhibitions and events

## Optional

- [Library for International & Public Affairs | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/library-international-and-public-affairs): Library for International & Public Affairs supporting graduate research
- [Education, Gerontology, & Social Work Library Services | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/edu-gero-social-work): Subject librarian services for Education, Gerontology, and Social Work
- [Grand Avenue Library | USC Libraries](https://libraries.usc.edu/locations/grand-avenue-library): Grand Avenue Library with book collections and electronic paging services
